summary: Cold attach of an Apple 140 W charger to the TPS25751 test board as sink. The capture is real; registers.json is synthesized from bench words in the native tests.

setup.sink: TPS25751 test board on its battery, configured from its EEPROM
setup.cable: Not recorded. Its SOP' Discover Identity ACK in capture.jsonl reports USB Vendor ID 0x20C2, Product ID 0x0005, bcdDevice 0x0310, Passive Cable.
setup.stimulus: Cold attach by hand, following the Phase 1 cold-attach steps
setup.operator: Library maintainer (cold attach); recorded by the km003c fork's Phase 4 cold-attach hardware test

notes: The header's provenance field is null and its label is "phase4 cold attach"; this file supplies the provenance.
The SOP messages match the Phase 1 reference capture of 2026-11-22 byte for byte, including the board's own Discover Identity ACK (VID 0x0451) 3 s after PS_RDY.
No Discover Identity ACK from the charger is on the wire, so this bundle cannot check RECEIVED_SOP_IDENTITY (0x48).

included.0x30: kRx140W in test_TPS25751Pdo.cpp (bench read 2026-11-22 with this charger): Number Valid PDOs 4 and PDOs 1 to 4. Bytes 17 to 52 (PDOs 5 to 7 and reserved bits 423:232) are zero, the TRM reset value; the bench words do not record them.
included.0x34: CHARGER_140W in test_TPS25751ActivePDOContract.cpp, as read from the board: active PDO 0x000641D6 and First PDO Control Bits 0x098.
included.0x35: BOARD_SINKING in test_TPS25751ActiveRDOContract.cpp: 0x4184B12C in bits 31:0 and bits 127:96, reserved bits 95:32 zero, the way two chargers read on hardware.

registers.length_bytes: Each length is the register size in the library's RegisterInfo (TRM SLVUCR8B), not a length byte read from the controller.
